title: Stonerack
description: This minecraft texture pack makes netherrack look like stone without changeing colors
body:
in this texture pack, i have taken the stone texture, and given it netherrack colors. this pack is going to siplify the colors and detail of netherrack, makeing the nether look much better. also this pack is good for ore hunting, as i have not changed the texture of ores. 

you may use this pack in a modpack without modifcation
